facts_verified.claim: The bounded synthetic path produces deterministic normalized rows for three cycles, five football league endpoints and the supported h2h/totals markets, with provider capture and market-source timestamps kept distinct.

H2H requires exactly home, draw and away; totals requires exactly one Over/Under pair at one point. Invalid or unavailable market branches are retained as explicit limitations rather than invented rows.

Every live payload is stored in an immutable raw R2 envelope and read back exactly before normalization and deterministic replay. If the first raw readback is absent, execution stops after one provider request and emits no false delivery artifact.

The consultable JSON, CSV and HTML contain normalized matches, odds, capture/source times, branch coverage, limitations and consumption. Raw provider payloads never enter Git or the public artifact; HTML escaping and CSV formula neutralization preserve safe consultation.
The runtime distinguishes market branch coverage from outcome-row counts, preserves each incomplete branch, and reports terminal fail-closed status separately from partial usable data.

No real match, odd, capture timestamp, provider cost or coverage was received during this offline review; the three real-data claim identifiers remain PARTIAL until post-merge execution and verified R2 replay.

unknowns: Actual provider rows, capture/source timestamps, bookmaker coverage and branch limitations remain unknown until the post-merge workflow receives and replays real data.
The current provider quota and exact historical pilot cost cannot be reconstructed from a future quota response alone.
R2 and provider availability remain external until execution.
assumptions: The existing provider continues to return its documented odds payload shape and quota headers.
The existing R2 bucket remains private and supports conditional immutable writes plus exact-key reads.
C0 will preserve PARTIAL evidence status until a real public receipt and durable private report are inspected.
main_objection: DP6 VERDICT: PASS_AND_HOLD with no P0 or P1 data objection. The normalized path is testable and fail-closed, but no real-data completeness statement is admissible before the post-merge receipt, exact R2 readback and artifact inspection.

risks.risk: A provider branch can legitimately contain no supported bookmaker or market; it must remain explicit and must not be converted into a synthetic complete row.
The public normalized artifact expires after fourteen days; R2 remains the durable source for raw replay and the run link must be delivered promptly.

minimum_decisive_test: After merge, accept the first provider branch only after immutable PUT, exact GET, envelope hash and deterministic replay; then inspect the final receipt, JSON, CSV and HTML for all real timestamps, coverage and limitations.
recommended_action: Accept the data key in PASS_AND_HOLD, complete governance and exact-head checks, then run the bounded workflow and promote the data claims only from the received and replay-verified artifacts.
scale_condition: Operational E1/PASS_AND_HOLD only; five endpoints do not prove a season or authorize scientific promotion.
estimated_compute: Read-only data-contract review plus targeted offline normalization, replay and rendering tests; no corpus replay.
estimated_external_cost: 0 provider request, 0 credit, 0 R2 operation, 0 purchase and 0 bet during DP6 review.
estimated_human_time: Approximately 30 minutes of active review, excluding C0 work and CI waits.
maintenance_impact: Moderate because the specialized result module is large; simplify only after the real path works and without changing stored data or historical evidence.
